source: VERIFICATION_PLAN.md privacy requirement; D-PRIVACY-001; locally inspected Playwright1.65 trace loader
raw: Keep original historical receipts and captured bytes unchanged and local/private. Future Playwright output starts under data/private-evidence, outside the receipt artifact tree. Review traces/reports are explicitly derived artifacts with original and sanitized whole-file hashes, policy/version and nonsecret edit counts.
redaction: Remove credential headers and cookie arrays; replace credential JSON/password-input values; remove credential header log lines; redact credential query parameters. Discover credential strings from those contexts and remove long values and encoded variants elsewhere, including DOM/log/source snapshots. Replace workspace/home paths with aliases. Never read, hash or archive .env to discover secrets.
preservation: Noncredential financial values, timestamps, counts, status/exit codes and images remain unchanged. Remap changed resource references and SHA1-of-source-path names consistently. Keep actual observed HTTP sizes/timings as recorded metadata; replacement bodies are explicitly redacted. Canonical ZIP metadata makes identical input/policy deterministic.
failure: Reject unsupported trace schemas, malformed records, encrypted/symlink/unsafe/duplicate ZIP members and bounded-size violations. A known credential in unsupported binary content fails closed. Partial/private capture or sanitization failure is never a passing or raw public artifact.
scope: Recognized HTTP/JSON/log/query/cookie/password-input credentials, discovered long-value propagation and declared path aliases on the controlled application capture surfaces. Not an assertion that arbitrary unknown secrets in user images/files can be identified. Provider credentials must remain backend-only independently.
verification: Authored fake credential sentinels, short-value noncorruption, nested/encoded propagation, deterministic/idempotent output, original preservation, intact JSON/numeric/image/source/resource references, malformed/failure paths, actual current success/failure browser captures, installed trace-viewer playback, historical derived copies and explicit exclusion of raw private evidence. Existing82 requirements/397 acceptance cases remain unchanged and uncertified until final release.
